function: Symbol detection at the BS of an uplink RIS-assisted massive MIMO system, using a deep-unfolded first-and-second momentum detector (DFSM-Det) (pp. 1-3).
system: Uplink: BS with 16 antennas, 8 or 12 single-antenna UEs, reflecting RIS with 16 unit-amplitude elements, flat Rayleigh fading, 16-QAM; band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: Deep-unfolded gradient descent with first and second momentum, 15 layers, trainable per-layer weights; supervised loss against the transmitted symbols, TensorFlow (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh flat fading, CN(0,1) entries; 100 realizations x 1000 symbols per UE, half for training and half for testing (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Train and test on two halves of the same simulated data; 8/16 and 12/16 loads, perfect CSI or error variance 0.05/0.1; no unseen-condition test (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE. Learned: DetNet, FS-Net, MomentNet, and OAMP-Net (model-driven); all earlier detectors, compared on BER (p. 4).
metrics: BER versus SNR (10-20 dB) at 16-QAM; additions and multiplications per layer; spectral radius versus step size (pp. 3-5).
complexity: Per layer, N²+6N additions and N²+5N multiplications with N=2Nt; Fig. 6 compares operation counts with DetNet, FS-Net, MomentNet, OAMP-Net (p. 5, Table I).
q1_support: p. 2: "QAM symbols over the Rayleigh fading channels to the BS and the RIS". Own Rayleigh simulator with CN(0,1) entries (p. 2); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "The DL networks are trained on half of the dataset over 10,000 iterations with a learning rate of 0.001, and tested on the remaining half." A held-out half of the same data. The paper never states that a model trained for one load (8/16 or 12/16) or CSI condition is tested on another; CSI-error sweeps do not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "including DetNet [6], FS-Net [7], and MomentNet [9]. Additionally, we provide the performance of OAMP-Net [8] and MMSE as the benchmarks." Figs. 3-5 compare their BER with DFSM-Det; MMSE is the non-learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 5: "we compare the computational complexity per network layer. Table I shows the complexity expressions." Table I gives DFSM-Det as N²+6N additions and N²+5N multiplications per layer; Fig. 6 plots the operation counts.
q5_support: p. 4: "Simulations are conducted over 100 flat fading channel realizations". Data come from the authors' own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset or measurements.
notes: Included in area 1: DFSM-Det is a deep-unfolded detector with trainable per-layer weights (p. 3), so it counts as learned; the RIS phases are random or set by the optimization method of [12] (p. 4), not learned. Table I and Fig. 6 (p. 5) were read from the page image because the text extraction omits them. q3: MMSE is the non-learned baseline; DetNet, FS-Net, MomentNet and OAMP-Net are earlier learned detectors, compared on BER. q2: the test set is a held-out half of the same data.
